Jordan — thanks again for the call today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft based on what we discussed. High-level recap and asks below.

Call highlights (from discovery):
- Primary use case: customer support retrieval + routing, ~10M tokens/month initially.
- Target latency: p95 < 300ms for short prompts; offline batch embeddings for long-tail.
- Security requirements: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS, VPC peering for private deployment.
- Timeline preference: pilot in Q2, production by mid-April.

Draft MAP (milestones & owners):
1) Legal review & NDA — target: 2026-03-17 — Owner: Sana Patel (Acme legal) — Dependency: standard SOW
2) Security questionnaire + evidence — target: 2026-03-20 — Owner: Priya Natarajan (Acme security) — Dependency: Redwood SOC 2 package (attached)
3) Technical onboarding (POC infra + sample data) — target: 2026-04-07 — Owner: TBD (Acme eng) + Redwood SE (Vivek) — Dependency: sample dataset, firewall rules
4) Pilot run & performance validation — target: 2026-04-21 — Owner: Jordan Lee (economic owner) / Redwood SEs — Dependency: completed onboarding
5) Procurement / PO signed — target: 2026-04-30 — Owner: Jordan Lee / Acme finance — Dependency: approved SOW and pricing

Action items for you: can you confirm the RACI for the following roles on your side so we can lock the MAP?
- Economic buyer
- Security owner
- Legal owner
- Engineering lead (technical owner for integration)

I've attached the MAP draft (Acme-Redwood-MAP-v0.2.docx) and the initial SOW scoping (acme-sow-scoping.pdf). If you'd like, I can update the MAP with the exact names/contacts and re-send.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm RACI owners and any date tweaks by EOD Friday 3/5
- Redwood SE (Vivek) to follow up on technical checklist and estimated time to POC
- Weekly sync cadence starting the week of 3/15 if dates hold

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Marissa Cole
